title.zh-CN: 引产后反复阴道大量流血 · 31岁女性
title.en: Recurrent heavy bleeding after an induced birth · 31-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 一位31岁女性在早产引产后不久开始阴道大量流血，反复3天后转来。
summary.en: A 31-year-old woman is transferred after three days of heavy vaginal bleeding that began soon after an induced preterm birth and keeps returning.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表的单例报告改写。本版本（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容，按阶段重新组织并改写为患者的口语，没有增加或改动任何数值、时间、药物或结局；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以相对时间表示。1.0.0版自身的不清楚或不一致之处（“再次入院”与“首次转入”是否同一次住院；主诉“3天”与三次住院的时间关系；CRP只给出约14.52–15.82 mg/L的范围；组织记录名为“排出组织”而正文写“宫颈组织”；宫颈阴道团块的测量方式；子宫切除标本中“皮下化脓性炎症”的部位；前后不一致、未给出数值的肌层厚度）全部保留并列入待核实。对话、担忧、阶段安排、决策、干预、评分和教学要点为教学设计；两张经审核的原图只在结局记录中展示。
notes.en: Adapted from a published single-case report. In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, reorganised by phase and reworded into the patient's lay speech; no value, timing, drug or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are relative. Version 1.0.0's own unclear or inconsistent points (whether its 'readmission' is the first transfer; how the 3-day chief complaint fits three admissions; a CRP given only as a range of about 14.52–15.82 mg/L; a tissue record titled 'expelled tissue' whose text says 'cervical tissue'; how the cervical and vaginal mass was measured; the site of the 'suppurative subcutaneous inflammation' in the hysterectomy specimen; an inconsistent myometrial thickness with no values given) are all kept and listed to verify. The dialogue, her worries, the phases, decisions, interventions, scoring and teaching points are educational design; the two approved figures from the report appear only with the outcome record.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对产后24小时以后的继发性产后出血，系统排查宫腔残留、子宫内膜炎、子宫复旧不良和胎盘植入：留取阴道拭子（怀疑感染时在用抗菌药物前留血培养），怀疑子宫内膜炎时静脉用抗菌药物（WHO 2015：克林霉素联合庆大霉素），由有经验的医生清除残留组织（RCOG 2016），鉴于她既往的子宫手术，在超声引导下进行。
learningOutcomes.en: Work up secondary postpartum haemorrhage for retained tissue, endometritis, subinvolution and a placenta accreta spectrum: take vaginal swabs (and blood cultures before antibiotics when infection is suspected), start IV antibiotics when endometritis is suspected (WHO 2015: clindamycin with gentamicin), and have an experienced obstetrician evacuate retained tissue (RCOG 2016), under ultrasound guidance given her previous uterine surgery.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 清宫后宫腔已空而子宫仍增大、回声不均，白细胞上升伴中性粒细胞升高时，即使没有明显发热，也判断为子宫壁的感染或坏死，安排断层影像，停止盲目刮宫。
learningOutcomes.en: Read an empty cavity with a still enlarged, heterogeneous uterus and a white count rising with neutrophilia as infection or necrosis of the uterine wall even without a marked fever, image it, and stop blind curettage.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对伴休克的继发性产后出血（血压53/34 mmHg）启动产科大出血预案：早期输注红细胞和血浆，持续出血时纤维蛋白原维持在2 g/L以上（RCOG 2016）；并说明为什么分娩3小时以后不再开始使用氨甲环酸（WHO 2017；WHO/FIGO/ICM 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Run the obstetric major haemorrhage response for secondary PPH with shock (BP 53/34 mmHg): red cells and plasma early and fibrinogen kept above 2 g/L during ongoing bleeding (RCOG 2016); and explain why tranexamic acid is not started more than 3 hours after the birth (WHO 2017; WHO/FIGO/ICM 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 可能存在脓毒性休克时，在1小时内给予广谱抗菌药物（SSC 2021；SMFM 2023），可能为坏死性或产毒素感染时加用克林霉素（IDSA 2014），并在条件允许时尽快完成感染源控制。
learningOutcomes.en: When septic shock is possible, give broad-spectrum antibiotics within the hour (SSC 2021; SMFM 2023), adding clindamycin when a necrotising or toxin-producing infection is possible (IDSA 2014), and achieve source control as soon as it is practical.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 宫颈处组织为大片坏死的子宫肌层时，选择开腹子宫切除去除感染源（IDSA 2014），而不是宫腔镜分离、保留子宫的局部切除或子宫动脉栓塞，并按《民法典》第一千二百一十九条向她本人说明风险和替代方案、取得她的明确同意。
learningOutcomes.en: When tissue from the cervix is extensive necrotic myometrium, choose laparotomy and hysterectomy to remove the source (IDSA 2014) rather than hysteroscopic separation, uterus-sparing excision or uterine artery embolisation, explaining the risks and alternatives to her and obtaining her explicit consent (Civil Code of China, Article 1219).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制定子宫切除后的计划：按培养和病情继续抗感染，出血控制后预防剂量低分子肝素至少10天（RCOG 2015），纠正贫血，安排心理支持和产后随访。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan care after the hysterectomy: antibiotics continued according to cultures and progress, prophylactic LMWH for at least 10 days once bleeding is controlled (RCOG 2015), correction of anaemia, psychological support and postnatal follow-up.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 引产以后下面一直反复出很多血，已经3天了
chiefComplaint.en: Since they induced the birth I keep bleeding heavily down below — it's been three days

triageNote.zh-CN: 31岁，孕28周多胎膜早破，约10小时后引产分娩；产后约2小时起阴道大量流血并曾休克（血压40/20 mmHg）。转出医院行清宫、会阴裂伤缝合、输血和促宫缩治疗后出血减少。引产后反复阴道多量流血3天。转入时体温37.4 ℃。
triageNote.en: 31-year-old; membranes ruptured at just over 28 weeks and the birth was induced about 10 hours later, with heavy vaginal bleeding from about 2 hours after it and shock (BP 40/20 mmHg). The transferring unit evacuated the uterus, repaired a perineal tear, transfused her and gave uterotonics, after which the bleeding lessened. 3 days of recurrent heavy vaginal bleeding since the induced birth. Temperature on arrival 37.4 °C.

tags.en: Recurrent bleeding after an induced birth

personality.zh-CN: 31岁，刚经历一次早产引产和几天来反复的大出血，身心都很疲惫，也很怕再出血；说话直接，愿意配合，会尽量把自己知道的说清楚。
personality.en: 31, worn out by an induced preterm birth and days of recurrent heavy bleeding, and frightened that it will happen again; direct and cooperative, she tries to tell you clearly what she knows.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子不长；不用医学术语，说不清的就直说不知道。
speechStyle.en: Everyday speech in short sentences; no medical terms, and she says so plainly when she does not know.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我引产以后下面一直反复出很多血，已经三天了，我好害怕。
openingLine.en: Doctor, ever since they induced the birth I keep bleeding heavily down below — three days now. I'm frightened.

concerns.en: Is this bleeding ever going to stop?

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是里面还有东西没清干净？
concerns.en: Is there still something left inside that wasn't cleared out?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 转入时：疲惫、害怕，但清醒配合，用自己的话回答，不用术语。再次清宫后：仍然担心，回答简短。第三次入院时：大出血后面色苍白、手脚发凉，只简短回答。只回答问到的内容，不增减任何数字、孕周或时间；问到不知道的事（比如宝宝的情况、药物过敏、以后的打算），就说说不上来，不要编。
actingNotes.en: On transfer: tired and frightened but alert and cooperative, answering in her own words without medical terms. After the repeat evacuation: still anxious, with brief answers. At the third admission: pale and cold after the bleed, answering only briefly. Answer only what is asked, never adding or changing numbers, weeks or times; for anything you do not know (the baby, allergies, plans for the future), say you are not sure — never invent.

label.en: Transfer: recurrent bleeding after the birth

description.zh-CN: 她在引产后反复阴道大量流血3天，此前出血时曾休克；转出医院已为她清宫、缝合会阴裂伤、输血并用了促宫缩药。她刚转到本院产科病房。
description.en: She has had three days of recurrent heavy vaginal bleeding after an induced birth, with shock during an earlier bleed; the transferring unit evacuated the uterus, repaired a perineal tear, transfused her and gave uterotonics. She has just arrived on the obstetric ward.

description.zh-CN: 她已再次清宫，回到病房。
description.en: She has had a repeat evacuation of the uterus and is back on the ward.

description.zh-CN: 本病例从这里按记录的病程展开：她第三次入院，再次阴道大量流血。两次住院之间的经过和间隔时间没有记录。
description.en: From here the case follows the recorded course: she is admitted for the third time, bleeding heavily again. What happened between the admissions, and how long it was, is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 原报告记录的病程与结局

text.zh-CN: 原报告记录：在宫腔镜下分离时发生穿孔，随后行宫底楔形切除；此后又大量出血，并发现感染，最终切除子宫，之后治愈出院。报告的诊断为坏死性子宫肌炎、子宫内膜炎及反复失血性休克。
text.en: As the report records it: a perforation occurred during hysteroscopic separation, and a wedge resection of the fundus followed; she then bled heavily again and infection was found, the uterus was finally removed, and she recovered and was discharged. The report's diagnosis was necrotising myometritis, endometritis and recurrent haemorrhagic shock.

note.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录各次手术之间的间隔、抗菌药物的使用、病原体、输血总量和远期恢复情况。

name.zh-CN: 静脉抗菌药物：克林霉素联合庆大霉素

dose.zh-CN: 先问过敏史，留取血培养和宫颈阴道拭子后给药：克林霉素900 mg静脉滴注，每8小时1次；庆大霉素5 mg/kg静脉滴注，每日1次（按肾功能和血药浓度调整）。
dose.en: Ask about allergies and take blood cultures and swabs first: clindamycin 900 mg IV every 8 hours with gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV once daily (adjusted to renal function and levels).

response.zh-CN: 已开始静脉用药。本病例没有记录她是否用过抗菌药物、用的哪一种；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is running. This case does not record whether antibiotics were given, or which; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 升级为广谱抗菌药物：哌拉西林他唑巴坦联合克林霉素
name.en: Escalate to broad-spectrum antibiotics: piperacillin–tazobactam with clindamycin

dose.zh-CN: 1小时内给药；若不致延误，先留血培养。哌拉西林他唑巴坦4.5 g静脉滴注，每6小时1次，加克林霉素900 mg静脉滴注，每8小时1次；有MRSA风险时加万古霉素；按微生物科意见调整。
dose.en: Within the hour, taking blood cultures first if that causes no delay: piperacillin–tazobactam 4.5 g IV every 6 hours with clindamycin 900 mg IV every 8 hours, adding vancomycin if MRSA is a risk; adjust with microbiology.

response.zh-CN: 已开始静脉用药。本病例没有记录她是否用过抗菌药物、用的哪一种；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is running. This case does not record whether antibiotics were given, or which; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 缩宫素5 U缓慢静脉注射（可重复1次），随后40 U加入500 mL等渗晶体液，以125 mL/h静脉滴注。
dose.en: Oxytocin 5 units by slow IV injection (may be repeated once), then 40 units in 500 mL of isotonic crystalloid at 125 mL/h.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例记录她转来前用过促宫缩药（药名和剂量没有记录）；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case records uterotonics before her transfer (drugs and doses not recorded); it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 超声引导下清除宫腔残留组织

dose.zh-CN: 在手术室由高年资产科医生在超声引导下清除宫腔内组织，组织送病理。
dose.en: In theatre, a senior obstetrician removes the tissue from the cavity under ultrasound guidance and sends it for histology.

harm.zh-CN: 她已经再次清过宫：再刮一次，是在可能已经发炎甚至坏死的子宫壁上操作，穿孔和大出血的风险高，还可能造成宫腔粘连，并会耽误她需要的静脉抗菌药物和影像检查。RCOG绿顶指南第52号（2016）的清宫针对的是残留的胎盘组织，没有残留就不应反复刮宫；坏死组织要靠手术去除（IDSA 2014）。留在宫颈或阴道里的组织，应在窥器下用卵圆钳轻柔取出送病理，而不是再搔刮子宫壁。
harm.en: She has already had a repeat evacuation: curetting again works on a uterine wall that may be inflamed or even necrotic, with a high risk of perforation and major bleeding and a risk of adhesions, and it delays the IV antibiotics and imaging she needs. RCOG Green-top Guideline 52 (2016) evacuates retained placental tissue — it does not repeat curettage without it — and necrotic tissue needs removal at surgery (IDSA 2014). Tissue lying in the cervix or vagina is eased out with sponge forceps under a speculum for histology — the uterine wall is not curetted again.

response.zh-CN: 清宫已完成，组织已送病理。原报告记录她曾再次清宫；本病例没有记录清宫时的所见和这次组织的病理。
response.en: The evacuation is done and the tissue sent for histology. The report records a repeat evacuation; this case does not record what was found or the histology of that tissue.

name.zh-CN: 宫腔镜下分离、切除宫腔内组织
name.en: Hysteroscopic separation and resection of the tissue

dose.zh-CN: 在手术室宫腔镜下分离并切除宫腔内的组织，尽量保留子宫。
dose.en: In theatre, separate and resect the tissue in the cavity hysteroscopically, aiming to keep the uterus.

harm.zh-CN: 在正在出血、可能已经感染、子宫壁可能已经病变的产后子宫上做宫腔镜分离或切除，穿孔和大出血的风险很高，而且处理不了子宫壁本身的病变。对继发性产后出血，RCOG绿顶指南第52号（2016）主张由有经验的医生实施或指导清宫来清除残留组织；宫腔已经空了以后，继续宫腔内操作没有帮助，坏死组织要靠手术去除（IDSA 2014）。
harm.en: Hysteroscopic separation or resection in a bleeding postpartum uterus that may be infected, and whose wall may itself be diseased, carries a high risk of perforation and major bleeding and does nothing about the wall. In secondary PPH, RCOG Green-top Guideline 52 (2016) has retained tissue removed by surgical evacuation undertaken or supervised by an experienced clinician; once the cavity is empty, more intrauterine instrumentation does not help, and necrotic tissue needs removal at surgery (IDSA 2014).

response.zh-CN: 已安排宫腔镜手术。原报告的处理经过见结局记录；本病例不模拟这次手术的效果。
response.en: Hysteroscopy is arranged. The report's course is in the outcome record; this case does not simulate the effect of this procedure.

dose.zh-CN: 在介入室经股动脉插管栓塞双侧子宫动脉。
dose.en: In the angiography suite, embolise both uterine arteries through a femoral catheter.

harm.zh-CN: 感染是子宫动脉栓塞的禁忌（危及生命的大出血时为相对禁忌）：栓塞本身可引起子宫坏死、栓塞后子宫内膜炎和脓肿，而且清除不了残留或坏死的组织。RCOG绿顶指南第52号（2016）把介入治疗作为合适病例的止血选择，而不是代替去除病灶；SSC 2021要求尽快控制感染源。休克时把她送去介入室，还会推迟手术止血和去除病灶。
harm.en: Infection is a contraindication to uterine artery embolisation (a relative one when bleeding is life-threatening): embolisation can itself cause uterine necrosis, post-embolisation endometritis and abscess, and it removes no retained or necrotic tissue. RCOG Green-top Guideline 52 (2016) offers interventional radiology for suitable cases of PPH, not in place of removing the source, and SSC 2021 asks for source control as soon as practical. In a woman in shock, a trip to the angiography suite also delays surgical control of the bleeding and of its source.

response.zh-CN: 她被送往介入室。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: She is taken to the angiography suite. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 呼叫上级，启动产科大出血应急预案
name.en: Call for help and activate the obstetric major haemorrhage protocol

dose.zh-CN: 呼叫产科上级医生和麻醉医生，通知血库和手术室，指定专人记录并计量失血。
dose.en: Call the senior obstetrician and the anaesthetist, alert the blood bank and theatre, and assign someone to record events and measure blood loss.

response.zh-CN: 上级医生和麻醉医生正在赶来，血库和手术室已接到通知。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The senior obstetrician and the anaesthetist are on their way; the blood bank and theatre are alerted. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 加温输注红细胞（未交叉配血时先用O型RhD阴性），早期同时输注新鲜冰冻血浆；持续出血时纤维蛋白原维持在2 g/L以上（用冷沉淀补充）；按凝血检查调整后续血制品。
dose.en: Warmed red cells (O RhD-negative until crossmatched blood is ready) with fresh frozen plasma early; keep fibrinogen above 2 g/L during ongoing bleeding (cryoprecipitate to replace it); further products guided by the clotting results.

response.zh-CN: 血制品正在输注。本病例记录她转来前输过血（量没有记录），没有记录第三次入院时是否输血；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Blood products are running. This case records a transfusion before her transfer (volume not recorded) but not whether she was transfused at the third admission; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 加温等渗晶体液，仅在等待血制品时短时使用，控制总量。
dose.en: Warmed isotonic crystalloid, only briefly while blood is prepared, keeping the volume limited.

response.zh-CN: 正在输注。本病例没有记录她的补液情况；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Running. This case does not record her fluids; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 氨甲环酸1 g静脉注射（10分钟以上）。
dose.en: Tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 minutes.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。WHO（2017年推荐，2025年综合指南沿用）不支持在分娩3小时以后才开始用氨甲环酸治疗产后出血；本病例没有记录是否用过，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. WHO (its 2017 recommendation, carried into the 2025 consolidated guideline) does not support starting tranexamic acid for postpartum haemorrhage more than 3 hours after the birth; this case does not record whether it was given and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 窥器下轻柔钳取组织并送病理
name.en: Ease out tissue under a speculum and send it for histology

dose.zh-CN: 窥器暴露后用卵圆钳轻柔夹出宫颈口或阴道内的组织，不搔刮子宫壁；组织送病理和培养。
dose.en: With a speculum in place, ease any tissue at the cervix or in the vagina out with sponge forceps, without curetting the uterine wall; send it for histology and culture.

response.zh-CN: 宫颈和阴道内的组织已取出，送检病理。本病例记录了宫颈处组织的病理，没有记录组织是怎样取得的；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The tissue is out and on its way to histology. This case records the histology of tissue from the cervix but not how it was obtained; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 复苏的同时开腹切除子宫，由高年资产科医生主刀，并与第二位有经验的产科医生共同决定；需要时请普外科协助；标本送病理和培养。
dose.en: Laparotomy and hysterectomy alongside resuscitation, led by a senior obstetrician and decided with a second experienced obstetrician; general surgical help if needed; specimens to histology and culture.

harm.zh-CN: 现在切除子宫为时过早：复旧不良的子宫里有残留组织，应先抗感染并由有经验的医生清宫（RCOG绿顶指南第52号，2016；子宫内膜炎用药见WHO 2015）；清宫后子宫仍不正常，需要的是静脉抗菌药物和影像检查，而不是马上切除。还没有坏死的证据、治疗也没有失败时，切除一位31岁女性的子宫，会让她永久失去生育能力；RCOG（2016）还要求切除子宫的决定有第二位有经验的医生参与。
harm.en: A hysterectomy at this stage is premature: retained tissue in a subinvoluted uterus is treated first with antibiotics and evacuation by an experienced clinician (RCOG Green-top Guideline 52, 2016; WHO 2015 for endometritis), and a uterus that stays abnormal afterwards needs IV antibiotics and imaging before anyone removes it. Without evidence of necrosis or of failed treatment, removing a 31-year-old's uterus ends her fertility for good; RCOG (2016) also asks for a second experienced clinician in any decision to remove the uterus.

response.zh-CN: 她被送进手术室行子宫切除。原报告的处理经过见结局记录；本病例不模拟手术的效果。
response.en: She is taken to theatre for the hysterectomy. The report's course is in the outcome record; this case does not simulate the effect of the operation.

name.zh-CN: 开腹局部切除，保留子宫
name.en: Laparotomy with local excision, keeping the uterus

dose.zh-CN: 开腹切除子宫的病变部位并修补子宫，保留生育能力。
dose.en: Open the abdomen, excise the affected part of the uterus and repair it to preserve fertility.

harm.zh-CN: 保留子宫的局部切除只见于病灶局限、病情稳定、充分知情的个案报道；子宫壁一旦坏死，局部切除很可能留下坏死、感染的肌层，再出血和感染持续的风险很高——IDSA 2014要求坏死性感染彻底清除坏死组织，SSC 2021要求有效控制感染源。没有证据表明子宫壁本身有病变时，更没有理由开腹切除。
harm.en: Uterus-sparing excision appears only in case reports of limited disease in stable, fully informed women; once the wall is necrotic, a local excision is likely to leave dead, infected muscle behind, with a high risk of further bleeding and continuing infection — IDSA 2014 calls for removal of all necrotic tissue in a necrotising infection, and SSC 2021 for effective source control. Without evidence that the wall itself is diseased, there is no reason to open the abdomen at all.

response.zh-CN: 她被送进手术室。原报告的处理经过见结局记录；本病例不模拟这次手术的效果。
response.en: She is taken to theatre. The report's course is in the outcome record; this case does not simulate the effect of this operation.

name.zh-CN: 术前谈话并取得她本人的知情同意
name.en: Pre-operative talk and her own informed consent

dose.zh-CN: 复苏的同时，由上级医生在床旁用她能听懂的话说明：为什么建议手术、其他办法和各自的风险、对今后生育的影响；问她希望谁在场；确认她理解后由她本人签字。
dose.en: Alongside resuscitation, the senior doctor explains at the bedside, in words she understands, why surgery is recommended, the alternatives and their risks, and what it means for future pregnancies; asks whom she wants present; checks her understanding; and she signs herself.

response.zh-CN: 谈话开始。本病例没有记录术前与她谈了什么。
response.en: The conversation begins. This case does not record what was said with her before the operation.

name.en: Admit to intensive care after the operation

dose.zh-CN: 联系ICU，术后转入重症监护室继续复苏和监护。
dose.en: Call ICU and admit her after the operation for continued resuscitation and monitoring.

response.zh-CN: ICU已接收她。本病例没有记录她术后在哪里监护。
response.en: ICU accepts her. This case does not record where she was cared for after the operation.

dose.zh-CN: 出血控制后开始：按体重给予预防剂量（如体重50–90 kg者依诺肝素40 mg皮下注射，每日1次），至少10天，危险因素持续时延长到产后6周；出血控制前用机械预防。
dose.en: Once bleeding is controlled: a weight-based prophylactic dose (enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneously once daily for 50–90 kg), for at least 10 days, extended to 6 weeks after the birth if risk factors persist; mechanical prophylaxis until then.

harm.zh-CN: 她正在出血，或出血还没有控制：这时用抗凝药会加重出血。活动性产后出血是低分子肝素的禁忌（RCOG 2015）；先用机械预防，出血控制后再开始。
harm.en: She is bleeding, or her bleeding is not yet controlled: anticoagulation now would add to it. Active postpartum bleeding is a contraindication to LMWH (RCOG 2015); use mechanical prophylaxis until haemostasis is secure, then start it.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。本病例没有记录血栓预防；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Started. This case does not record thromboprophylaxis; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 安排心理支持和产后随访
name.en: Arrange psychological support and postnatal follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 请围产期心理（精神卫生）团队评估；与她一起回顾这次分娩和手术经过；安排产后复诊（恢复情况、贫血、情绪）。
dose.en: Ask the perinatal mental health team to see her; offer a debrief of the birth and the operations; book a postnatal review (recovery, anaemia, mood).

response.zh-CN: 已安排。本病例没有记录她的心理状况和随访。
response.en: Arranged. This case does not record her mood or her follow-up.

title.zh-CN: 问清这次出血和分娩的经过
title.en: Take the history of the bleeding and the birth

hint.zh-CN: 出血从什么时候开始、后来怎样变化？这次是怎样分娩的，转来前做过哪些处理？她以前的子宫手术和有没有发热，对判断原因各有什么意义？
hint.en: When did the bleeding start, and how has it behaved since? How did the birth go, and what was done before the transfer? What do her past uterine surgery and her temperature tell you about the cause?

guidance.zh-CN: 她清醒，能自己回答问题。
guidance.en: She is alert and answers for herself.

title.zh-CN: 检查子宫，看转入时的检查结果
title.en: Examine her uterus and read the transfer results

hint.zh-CN: 宫底的高度和子宫的软硬说明什么？超声和这次的白细胞计数，分别能说明什么、不能说明什么？
hint.en: What do the height and tone of the fundus tell you? What can the scan and this white count tell you — and what can they not?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁查体并做床旁超声；血标本在床旁留取，结果可在病历终端或床旁查看。
guidance.en: Examine and scan her at the bedside; bloods are taken there, and results are read at a records terminal or at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 决定转入后的处理并实施
title.en: Decide and act on the transfer findings

hint.zh-CN: 宫腔里还有组织时，只用促宫缩药够不够？她的既往手术史让清宫多了什么风险——谁来做、做之前要准备什么？
hint.en: With tissue still in the cavity, are uterotonics enough on their own? What extra risk does her surgical history add to an evacuation — who should do it, and what must be ready first?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策 1，然后实施你的方案。
guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board, then carry out your plan.

hint.zh-CN: 清宫以后，超声和化验告诉你宫腔和子宫壁各是什么情况？白细胞和CRP的变化，与她的体温放在一起怎么看？
hint.en: After the evacuation, what do the scan and the blood tests tell you about the cavity, and about the uterine wall? How do you weigh the white count and CRP against her temperature?

guidance.zh-CN: 她已再次清宫，回到病房。
guidance.en: She has had the repeat evacuation and is back on the ward.

title.en: Stabilise her and establish the cause

hint.zh-CN: 她现在的血压、脉搏和面色怎样，窥器下看到了什么？如果宫颈或阴道里有组织，应该怎么处理、送什么检查？除了失血，还有什么可能让她的循环变差？
hint.en: What are her blood pressure, pulse and colour now, and what does a speculum show? If there is tissue at the cervix or in the vagina, how should it be handled, and what test should it go for? Besides blood loss, what else could be making her circulation fail?

guidance.zh-CN: 她第三次入院，正在大量出血。
guidance.en: She has been admitted for the third time and is bleeding heavily.

title.zh-CN: 确定性治疗、术后计划和原报告的结局
title.en: Definitive treatment, the plan after it, and the reported outcome

hint.zh-CN: 坏死的组织，抗菌药物能不能到达？保留子宫的代价是什么，谁来决定？术后她面临哪些新的风险？最后，把原报告的经过和你的处理比一比。
hint.en: Can antibiotics reach dead tissue? What would keeping the uterus cost, and who decides? What new risks does she face after the operation? Finally, compare the report's course with what you did.

guidance.zh-CN: 宫颈处组织的病理已经回报；她仍需要你决定下一步。
guidance.en: The histology of the tissue from the cervix is back; she still needs you to decide what comes next.

prompt.zh-CN: 31岁，孕28周多胎膜早破，约10小时后引产分娩；产后约2小时起大出血并曾休克（血压40/20 mmHg），经清宫、会阴裂伤缝合、输血和促宫缩治疗后出血减少；引产后反复阴道多量流血3天转入。既往剖宫产1次、人工流产4次。体温37.4 ℃，宫底平脐、子宫收缩差；超声见宫腔内约28×18×36 mm不均质团块；白细胞13.04×10⁹/L。你的判断和处理是什么？
prompt.en: A 31-year-old whose membranes ruptured at just over 28 weeks had an induced birth about 10 hours later; heavy bleeding from about 2 hours after it, with shock (BP 40/20 mmHg), lessened after evacuation, perineal repair, transfusion and uterotonics, but she has had 3 days of recurrent heavy bleeding. One previous caesarean and four terminations. Temperature 37.4 °C; the fundus is at the umbilicus and poorly contracted; ultrasound shows a heterogeneous 28 × 18 × 36 mm mass in the cavity; white cells 13.04×10⁹/L. What is your assessment and plan?

need.zh-CN: 先问清出血、分娩、此前的处理和子宫手术史，测体温、检查子宫，并看转入时的超声和血常规。
need.en: Take the history of the bleeding, the birth, the treatment so far and her past uterine surgery, check her temperature and uterus, and read the transfer scan and blood count first.

text.zh-CN: 继发性产后出血：宫腔残留组织可能已合并感染，还要警惕胎盘植入。交叉配血，留培养后静脉用抗菌药物，给促宫缩药，由高年资医生在超声引导下清宫并备好血
text.en: Secondary PPH from retained tissue that may be infected, accreta in mind: crossmatch, cultures then IV antibiotics, a uterotonic, and evacuation by a senior under ultrasound guidance with blood ready

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。产后24小时以后的异常出血属于继发性产后出血，最常见的原因是宫腔残留和子宫内膜炎。RCOG绿顶指南第52号（2016）要求留取阴道拭子（发热时加做血培养）、怀疑子宫内膜炎时用抗菌药物，并由有经验的医生清宫；怀疑感染时，在第一剂抗菌药物前留好培养并不费事；WHO（2015）推荐克林霉素联合庆大霉素治疗产后子宫内膜炎（用药前先问过敏史，本病例没有记录）。她有一次剖宫产和4次人流，清宫要由高年资医生在超声引导下进行，并备好血制品。
feedback.en: Right. Abnormal bleeding more than 24 hours after a birth is secondary postpartum haemorrhage, most often from retained tissue and endometritis. RCOG Green-top Guideline 52 (2016) asks for vaginal swabs (and blood cultures if she is febrile), antibiotics when endometritis is suspected and evacuation by an experienced clinician; cultures taken before the first antibiotic dose cost nothing when infection is suspected; WHO (2015) recommends clindamycin with gentamicin for postpartum endometritis (ask about allergies first — the case does not record them). With one caesarean and four terminations behind her, the evacuation belongs to a senior under ultrasound guidance, with blood ready.

text.zh-CN: 继发性产后出血，原因是宫腔残留组织：给促宫缩药，安排在下一个常规手术日清宫；体温37.4 ℃和白细胞13.04×10⁹/L在产后都常见，暂不用抗菌药物
text.en: Secondary PPH from retained tissue: a uterotonic and evacuation on the next routine theatre list; a temperature of 37.4 °C and white cells of 13.04×10⁹/L are common after a birth, so no antibiotics yet

feedback.zh-CN: 残留组织的判断合理，产后白细胞也确实可以生理性升高，但这不是暂不用抗菌药物的理由：复旧不良、仍在出血的子宫里有残留组织，正是子宫内膜炎的典型背景（RCOG 2016；WHO 2015）。她出血时休克过一次，又反复大量出血3天，清宫不能等常规手术日。
feedback.en: Retained tissue is a fair reading, and postpartum white counts can be physiologically raised, but that is no reason to hold antibiotics: retained tissue in a subinvoluted, bleeding uterus is the classic setting of endometritis (RCOG 2016; WHO 2015). After shock with one bleed and 3 days of recurrent heavy bleeding, the evacuation cannot wait for a routine list.

text.zh-CN: 以子宫收缩乏力为主：缩宫素静滴加卡前列素，按摩子宫，暂不做宫腔操作；出血再增多时做子宫动脉栓塞，同时继续观察体温
text.en: Mainly uterine atony: an oxytocin infusion with carboprost and uterine massage, no intrauterine procedure for now, and uterine artery embolisation if the bleeding increases, watching her temperature meanwhile

feedback.zh-CN: 子宫收缩差是真的，但超声显示宫腔里还有约28×18×36 mm的团块：残留组织会妨碍子宫收缩，单靠促宫缩药很难止血，也处理不了可能的感染，RCOG（2016）对有残留的继发性产后出血主张清宫。可能感染时，子宫动脉栓塞是相对禁忌，它也取不出残留组织。
feedback.en: The poor tone is real, but the scan shows a 28 × 18 × 36 mm mass still in the cavity: retained tissue stops the uterus contracting, so drugs alone rarely control the bleeding and do nothing for a possible infection; RCOG (2016) evacuates retained tissue in secondary PPH. With infection possible, embolisation is relatively contraindicated, and it does not remove retained tissue.

text.zh-CN: 一次剖宫产加4次人流，宫腔里的不均质团块应按胎盘植入处理：不清宫，配好血后直接切除子宫，以免再次大出血
text.en: With one caesarean and four terminations, the heterogeneous mass should be treated as placenta accreta: no evacuation, and a hysterectomy once blood is crossmatched, to prevent another major bleed

feedback.zh-CN: 她确有胎盘植入的危险因素，值得警惕，但现有影像没有记录任何植入征象。继发性产后出血合并宫腔残留，按RCOG（2016）先抗感染、由有经验的医生清宫；切除子宫是其他止血办法都失败后的最后选择，对31岁的她还意味着永久失去生育能力。怀疑植入时，应由高年资医生评估并做好大出血准备，而不是马上切除子宫。
feedback.en: She does carry risk factors for placenta accreta, which deserve respect, but no imaging feature of accreta is recorded. Secondary PPH with retained tissue is managed first with antibiotics and evacuation by an experienced clinician (RCOG 2016); hysterectomy is the last resort once other measures fail and, at 31, ends her fertility. A suspected accreta calls for senior assessment and preparation for haemorrhage, not an immediate hysterectomy.

prompt.zh-CN: 再次清宫后，超声示宫腔内已无占位，但子宫仍增大、实质回声不均；白细胞由13.04升至16.12×10⁹/L，中性粒细胞升高；CRP约14.52–15.82 mg/L；没有明显发热。你怎么看，下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: After the repeat evacuation the cavity is empty on ultrasound, but the uterus is still enlarged with a heterogeneous echotexture; white cells have risen from 13.04 to 16.12×10⁹/L with raised neutrophils; CRP is about 14.52–15.82 mg/L; there is no marked fever. How do you read this, and what next?

need.zh-CN: 先看清宫后的超声、血常规和CRP，并复测体温。
need.en: Read the post-evacuation scan, blood count and CRP, and recheck her temperature first.

text.zh-CN: 考虑子宫壁感染或坏死：留血培养后静脉用覆盖厌氧菌的广谱抗菌药物，做增强CT或MRI找坏死、积气或脓肿，留院由上级医生复评，不再刮宫
text.en: Suspect infection or necrosis of the uterine wall: blood cultures, then broad-spectrum IV antibiotics with anaerobic cover, contrast CT or MRI for necrosis, gas or abscess, and senior review in hospital — no more curettage

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。宫腔已空而子宫仍大、回声不均，白细胞还在上升（13.04→16.12×10⁹/L，中性粒细胞升高），问题已经在子宫壁本身。没有明显发热不能排除深部或坏死性感染，产后白细胞要看趋势和临床表现。SMFM（2023）和SSC（2021）都要求怀疑脓毒症时留培养、尽快给予广谱抗菌药物，并尽早查明需要处理的感染源。
feedback.en: Right. With an empty cavity, an enlarged heterogeneous uterus and a white count still rising (13.04 → 16.12×10⁹/L, with neutrophilia), the problem lies in the uterine wall. No marked fever does not exclude a deep or necrotising infection, and a postpartum white count is read by its trend and the clinical picture. SMFM (2023) and SSC (2021) call for cultures, prompt broad-spectrum antibiotics and early identification of any source that needs control.

text.zh-CN: 超声可能漏掉了长在肌层里的残留胎盘：在静脉抗菌药物的同时，由上级医生在超声引导下第三次清宫，加用缩宫素促进子宫复旧，术后复查超声和血常规
text.en: The scan may be missing placenta embedded in the wall: IV antibiotics, with a third evacuation under ultrasound guidance and oxytocin to help the uterus involute, then a repeat scan and blood count to confirm the cavity is clear

feedback.zh-CN: 抗菌药物是对的，但宫腔已经空了：在一个可能已经发炎甚至坏死的子宫壁上再次刮宫，穿孔和大出血的风险很高，也去除不了肌层里的病变。RCOG（2016）的清宫指征是宫腔内的残留组织；现在需要的是影像检查，弄清子宫壁的情况。
feedback.en: Antibiotics are right, but the cavity is empty: curetting again on a uterine wall that may be inflamed or even necrotic carries a high risk of perforation and major bleeding and cannot remove disease within the muscle. RCOG (2016) evacuates for retained tissue in the cavity; what she needs now is imaging of the wall.

text.zh-CN: 没有明显发热，白细胞升高可能是清宫后的应激反应：改口服抗菌药物和铁剂，出院，1周后门诊复查超声、血常规和CRP，发热随时返院
text.en: With no real fever, the rising white count may be a stress response to the evacuation: oral antibiotics and iron, discharge, and an outpatient scan, blood count and CRP in a week, returning at once if a fever appears

feedback.zh-CN: 这是把“不发热”当成“没有严重感染”。白细胞从13.04升到16.12×10⁹/L、中性粒细胞升高，CRP约14.52–15.82 mg/L，子宫又增大、回声不均，都指向子宫壁的感染。SSC（2021）和SMFM（2023）要求对可能的脓毒症静脉用药并尽快评估感染源，而不是让她带着正在进展的感染回家。
feedback.en: This reads 'no fever' as 'no serious infection'. A white count rising from 13.04 to 16.12×10⁹/L with neutrophilia, a CRP of about 14.52–15.82 mg/L and an enlarged, heterogeneous uterus all point to infection of the wall. SSC (2021) and SMFM (2023) treat possible sepsis with IV antibiotics and prompt assessment of the source, not discharge with an infection that is still advancing.

text.zh-CN: 子宫增大、回声不均提示血管异常或胎盘植入：先做预防性子宫动脉栓塞以防再次大出血，再静脉用抗菌药物，在病房密切观察出血和体温
text.en: An enlarged, heterogeneous uterus suggests a vascular lesion or placenta accreta: prophylactic uterine artery embolisation to prevent another major bleed, then IV antibiotics with close watch on the bleeding and her temperature

feedback.zh-CN: 血管病变和植入值得排除，但应先由影像回答，而不是直接栓塞。白细胞上升、中性粒细胞升高提示子宫可能已经感染，而感染是子宫动脉栓塞的禁忌：栓塞本身可引起子宫坏死、子宫内膜炎和脓肿，也处理不了感染源（SSC 2021要求尽快查明需要控制的感染源）。
feedback.en: A vascular lesion or accreta is worth excluding, but imaging answers that before anyone embolises. A rising white count with neutrophilia suggests the uterus may be infected, and infection is a contraindication to embolisation, which can itself cause uterine necrosis, endometritis and abscess and does nothing for the source (SSC 2021: identify a source needing control promptly).

prompt.zh-CN: 她第三次入院，再次阴道大量流血：血压53/34 mmHg，脉搏110次/分，面色苍白，四肢发冷；宫颈及阴道内有一团块，记录的大小为70×62×51 mm。接下来几分钟你怎么做？
prompt.en: At her third admission she is bleeding heavily again: BP 53/34 mmHg, pulse 110/min, pale, with cold limbs; there is a mass within the cervix and vagina, recorded as 70 × 62 × 51 mm. What do you do in the next few minutes?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次发生了什么，测血压和脉搏，看她的面色和四肢，并做窥器检查。
need.en: Find out what has happened, take her blood pressure and pulse, look at her colour and limbs, and examine the cervix and vagina first.

text.zh-CN: 呼叫上级、启动产科大出血预案：两条大口径通路，加温输注红细胞并早期输血浆，纤维蛋白原维持在2 g/L以上；轻柔取出宫颈处组织送病理；1小时内静脉广谱抗菌药物；通知手术室
text.en: Call for help and run the obstetric haemorrhage protocol: two large-bore lines, warmed red cells with early plasma, fibrinogen above 2 g/L; ease out the tissue at the cervix for histology; broad-spectrum IV antibiotics within the hour; alert theatre

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。血压53/34 mmHg是危及生命的失血性休克：按WHO/FIGO/ICM（2025）和RCOG（2016）启动大出血流程，尽早输注红细胞和血浆，持续出血时纤维蛋白原维持在2 g/L以上。宫颈处的组织轻柔取出送病理，既能减少出血，也能明确病因。她此前白细胞已在上升，休克也可能有脓毒症的成分，SSC（2021）和SMFM（2023）要求1小时内给予广谱抗菌药物。
feedback.en: Right. A BP of 53/34 mmHg is life-threatening haemorrhagic shock: run the major haemorrhage response (WHO/FIGO/ICM 2025; RCOG 2016), with early red cells and plasma and fibrinogen kept above 2 g/L while she bleeds. Easing out the tissue at the cervix reduces the bleeding and sends the diagnosis to histology. Her white count was already rising, so sepsis may be part of the shock: SSC (2021) and SMFM (2023) give broad-spectrum antibiotics within the hour.

text.zh-CN: 按脓毒性休克处理：3小时内快速输注30 mL/kg晶体液，等血红蛋白结果出来再决定是否输血；留血培养后静脉用广谱抗菌药物；宫颈处团块暂不处理
text.en: Treat it as septic shock: 30 mL/kg of crystalloid within 3 hours, deciding on blood once the haemoglobin is back; blood cultures, then broad-spectrum IV antibiotics; leave the mass at the cervix for now

feedback.zh-CN: 抗菌药物是对的，但她正在大量出血：30 mL/kg晶体液是脓毒症低灌注的补液方案（SSC 2021），用在失血性休克上会稀释凝血因子、延误输血。急性失血时血红蛋白滞后于实际失血，输血要根据临床情况决定，不能等化验结果；团块留在宫颈里还会继续出血。
feedback.en: Antibiotics are right, but she is bleeding heavily: 30 mL/kg of crystalloid is the sepsis-hypoperfusion regimen (SSC 2021), and in haemorrhagic shock it dilutes clotting factors and delays blood. The haemoglobin lags behind acute loss, so transfusion follows the clinical picture rather than waiting for a result, and the mass left in the cervix keeps bleeding.

text.zh-CN: 启动大出血预案并输注红细胞，立即送介入室做子宫动脉栓塞止血，等血压稳定、出血停止后再处理宫颈处的团块
text.en: Run the haemorrhage protocol with red cells and send her straight to the angiography suite for uterine artery embolisation, dealing with the mass at the cervix once she is stable and dry

feedback.zh-CN: 启动预案和输血是对的，但栓塞不适合她：子宫可能已经感染，感染是栓塞的禁忌，栓塞本身还会引起子宫坏死；团块留在宫颈里会继续出血，也拿不到病理诊断；休克时转运去介入室还会推迟手术止血。RCOG（2016）把介入栓塞作为合适病例的止血选择，而不是代替去除病灶。
feedback.en: The protocol and blood are right, but embolisation does not suit her: the uterus may be infected, infection is a contraindication, and embolisation can itself cause uterine necrosis; the mass left in the cervix keeps bleeding and withholds the diagnosis; and a transfer to the angiography suite in shock delays surgical control. RCOG (2016) offers embolisation for suitable cases, not in place of removing the source.

text.zh-CN: 启动大出血预案并输注红细胞，在床旁用大号刮匙把宫颈和宫腔里的组织刮出来，再静滴缩宫素和卡前列素促进宫缩
text.en: Run the haemorrhage protocol with red cells, curette the tissue out of the cervix and cavity at the bedside with a large curette, then oxytocin and carboprost to contract the uterus

feedback.zh-CN: 启动预案和输血是对的，但不要刮宫：宫腔已经清过两次，子宫壁增大、回声不均，可能已经发炎甚至坏死，床旁用刮匙搔刮会造成穿孔和更大的出血。宫颈和阴道里的组织应在窥器下用卵圆钳轻柔取出送病理（RCOG 2016要求宫腔操作由有经验的医生进行），同时1小时内给予抗菌药物（SSC 2021）。
feedback.en: The protocol and blood are right, but do not curette: the cavity has been evacuated twice and the enlarged, heterogeneous wall may be inflamed or necrotic, so bedside curettage risks perforation and worse bleeding. Ease the tissue out of the cervix and vagina with sponge forceps under a speculum for histology (RCOG 2016: intrauterine procedures by an experienced clinician), with antibiotics within the hour (SSC 2021).

prompt.zh-CN: 宫颈处组织的病理结果：大片子宫肌层坏死，伴炎性渗出。确定性治疗怎么选？
prompt.en: The histology of the tissue from the cervix shows extensive necrosis of the myometrium with inflammatory exudate. What is the definitive treatment?

need.zh-CN: 先作出决策 3，并看宫颈处组织的病理结果。
need.en: Answer decision 3 and read the histology of the tissue from the cervix first.

text.zh-CN: 复苏的同时尽快开腹切除子宫，继续含克林霉素的静脉广谱抗菌药物；术前向她本人说明为什么不能安全地保留子宫，取得她的同意
text.en: Hysterectomy at laparotomy as soon as resuscitation allows, with broad-spectrum IV antibiotics including clindamycin — after explaining to her why her uterus cannot safely be kept, and taking her consent

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。大片肌层坏死伴炎性渗出，又有反复失血性休克，这是需要手术去除的坏死性感染：IDSA（2014）对坏死性感染要求及时手术清除坏死组织并联合广谱抗菌药物，克林霉素可抑制链球菌毒素；SSC（2021）要求尽快完成感染源控制。对子宫来说，这就是子宫切除。手术前按《民法典》第一千二百一十九条向她本人说明风险和替代方案，取得她的明确同意。
feedback.en: Right. Extensive myometrial necrosis with inflammatory exudate, after recurrent haemorrhagic shock, is a necrotising infection that needs surgery: IDSA (2014) treats necrotising infection with prompt removal of dead tissue plus broad-spectrum antibiotics, clindamycin suppressing streptococcal toxin; SSC (2021) asks for source control as soon as practical. For the uterus, that means hysterectomy. Before it, explain the risks and alternatives to her and obtain her explicit consent (Civil Code of China, Article 1219).

text.zh-CN: 宫腔镜下分离并切除宫腔里剩下的坏死组织，尽量保留子宫，术后继续静脉抗菌药物，复查超声看宫腔是否清干净，并向她说明这样能保留生育能力
text.en: Hysteroscopic separation and resection of the necrotic tissue left in the cavity, keeping the uterus if possible, with IV antibiotics continued and a repeat scan to check the cavity is clear, explaining that this keeps her fertility

feedback.zh-CN: 坏死的是子宫壁本身：宫腔镜去除不了坏死的肌层，还很容易穿透脆弱的子宫壁、引起大出血，保留子宫也就留下了感染源。坏死性感染需要手术去除坏死组织（IDSA 2014；SSC 2021要求尽快控制感染源）。
feedback.en: The necrosis is in the uterine wall itself: hysteroscopy cannot remove necrotic muscle and easily breaches a friable wall, with major bleeding — and keeping the uterus leaves the source behind. A necrotising infection needs surgical removal of the dead tissue (IDSA 2014; SSC 2021: source control as soon as practical).

text.zh-CN: 开腹局部切除坏死的子宫肌层并修补子宫，保留生育能力；术后静脉抗菌药物，必要时再次手术探查，并事先向她说明再次手术的可能
text.en: Laparotomy with local excision of the necrotic myometrium and repair of the uterus to keep her fertility; IV antibiotics afterwards and a second-look operation if needed, explained to her beforehand

feedback.zh-CN: 保留子宫的局部切除只见于病灶局限、病情稳定的个案报道；她是大片肌层坏死，并已两次失血性休克，局部切除很可能留下坏死和感染的肌层，再出血和感染的风险很高。IDSA（2014）要求彻底清除坏死组织。她的生育愿望应当问清楚、认真对待，但不能以她的生命为代价。
feedback.en: Uterus-sparing excision appears only in case reports of limited disease in stable women; with extensive necrosis and two episodes of haemorrhagic shock, a local excision is likely to leave necrotic, infected muscle behind, with high risks of rebleeding and continuing infection. IDSA (2014) calls for complete removal of dead tissue. Her wishes about fertility must be asked about and respected — but not at the cost of her life.

text.zh-CN: 先静脉广谱抗菌药物48–72小时，同时做子宫动脉栓塞止血；只有出现高热或再次大出血时才手术，其间每天复查血常规和CRP
text.en: Broad-spectrum IV antibiotics for 48–72 hours with uterine artery embolisation to stop the bleeding, operating only if a high fever or another major bleed follows, with a blood count and CRP every day

feedback.zh-CN: 抗菌药物到达不了坏死组织，单靠用药控制不了坏死性感染，等待只会让感染扩散（IDSA 2014；SSC 2021要求尽快控制感染源）。到目前为止的记录里她都没有明显发热，等“高热”出现才手术会错过时机；在感染的子宫上栓塞还可能加重坏死。
feedback.en: Antibiotics do not reach dead tissue, so drugs alone do not control a necrotising infection, and waiting lets it spread (IDSA 2014; SSC 2021: source control as soon as practical). No marked fever is recorded at any point so far, so waiting for a 'high fever' means waiting too long, and embolising an infected uterus can extend the necrosis.

prompt.zh-CN: 她已经做了子宫切除。术后头几天的计划是什么？
prompt.en: She has had her uterus removed. What is your plan for the first days after the operation?

need.zh-CN: 先作出决策 4，并完成手术。
need.en: Answer decision 4 and carry out the operation first.

text.zh-CN: 转入ICU或高依赖病房；按培养和病情继续静脉抗菌药物；出血控制后低分子肝素预防血栓至少10天；纠正贫血；安排心理支持
text.en: ICU or high-dependency care; IV antibiotics continued and guided by cultures; prophylactic LMWH once bleeding is controlled, for at least 10 days; correct anaemia; psychological support

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。产褥期手术、再次入院、感染、早产、大量失血和输血都会增加产后静脉血栓风险：RCOG绿顶指南第37a号（2015）建议出血控制后给予至少10天的预防剂量低分子肝素，危险因素持续时延长。抗菌药物的疗程按培养结果和临床反应决定（SSC 2021），不在切除后立刻停用。失去子宫、早产和反复大出血，都需要心理支持和后续随访。
feedback.en: Right. Surgery in the puerperium, readmission, infection, preterm birth, major blood loss and transfusion all raise her postnatal thrombosis risk: RCOG Green-top Guideline 37a (2015) advises prophylactic LMWH for at least 10 days once bleeding is controlled, extended when risk factors persist. Antibiotic duration follows cultures and clinical response (SSC 2021), not the moment the uterus is out. The loss of her uterus, a preterm birth and repeated major bleeds call for psychological support and follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 感染源已经切除，术后停用抗菌药物；因为刚大出血，6周内不用任何抗凝药，只鼓励早下床；回普通病房，复查血红蛋白后再定是否输血
text.en: The source is out, so stop the antibiotics after the operation; after such bleeding, no anticoagulant for 6 weeks, just early mobilisation; back to the general ward, with a haemoglobin check to decide on transfusion

feedback.zh-CN: 切除子宫后感染并不会立刻消失，抗菌药物要按培养和病情决定疗程（SSC 2021）。出血控制后，她的血栓风险远高于出血风险：RCOG 37a（2015）建议预防剂量低分子肝素，只靠早下床不够。刚经历严重感染和急诊大手术，术后早期也需要更高级别的监护。
feedback.en: Infection does not vanish when the uterus is removed; antibiotic duration follows cultures and progress (SSC 2021). Once bleeding is controlled her thrombosis risk outweighs her bleeding risk: RCOG 37a (2015) advises prophylactic LMWH, and early mobilisation alone is not enough. After a severe infection and major emergency surgery she also needs a higher level of monitoring early on.

text.zh-CN: 术后立即给予治疗剂量的低分子肝素，因为脓毒症、手术和产褥期的血栓风险极高；抗菌药物改为口服；第3天出院
text.en: Treatment-dose LMWH straight after the operation, given the very high clot risk of sepsis, surgery and the puerperium; switch to oral antibiotics; home on day 3

feedback.zh-CN: 血栓风险高是对的，但预防不等于治疗：没有血栓时用预防剂量，而且要等出血控制以后再开始（RCOG 37a，2015）。术后立即用治疗剂量可能引起腹腔内再出血。刚做完急诊子宫切除、感染还在控制中，改口服抗菌药物并第3天出院都太早。
feedback.en: The clot risk is high, but prevention is not treatment: without a thrombosis the dose is prophylactic, and it starts once bleeding is controlled (RCOG 37a, 2015). A treatment dose straight after surgery risks bleeding into the abdomen again. With an emergency hysterectomy just done and the infection still being controlled, oral antibiotics and discharge on day 3 are far too early.

text.zh-CN: 回普通病房常规护理；抗菌药物再用24小时；出院前复查血红蛋白；心理方面的问题等她自己提出时再转介
text.en: Back to the general ward for routine care; antibiotics for 24 more hours; a haemoglobin check before discharge; a referral for psychological support if she raises it herself

feedback.zh-CN: 24小时的抗菌药物适合预防手术感染，不适合正在治疗的坏死性感染，疗程要按培养和病情决定（SSC 2021）。这里也没有提血栓预防，而她有多项产后血栓危险因素（RCOG 37a，2015）。失去子宫后的心理支持应主动提供，而不是等她开口。
feedback.en: Twenty-four hours of antibiotics suits surgical prophylaxis, not a necrotising infection under treatment, whose course follows cultures and progress (SSC 2021). Thromboprophylaxis is missing despite several postnatal risk factors (RCOG 37a, 2015). Psychological support after losing her uterus is offered, not left for her to ask for.

text.zh-CN: 问清出血的起病和经过、分娩经过、出血时的休克症状、转来前的处理和既往子宫手术，并追问发热、腹痛、分泌物气味、胎盘情况、用药、过敏和宝宝的情况
text.en: Took the history of the bleeding and its course, the birth, the symptoms of shock, the treatment before transfer and her past uterine surgery, and asked about fever, pain, offensive discharge, the placenta, medicines, allergies and the baby

text.zh-CN: 转入时测体温、触诊宫底和宫缩，清宫后复测体温，第三次入院时测血压脉搏、看面色和四肢并做窥器检查
text.en: Took her temperature and felt the fundus and its tone on transfer, rechecked her temperature after the evacuation, and at the third admission took her blood pressure and pulse, looked at her colour and limbs and examined her with a speculum

text.zh-CN: 看过转入时和清宫后的超声和血常规、清宫后的CRP以及宫颈处组织的病理，并在转入时送检交叉配血
text.en: Read the scans and blood counts at transfer and after the evacuation, the CRP after it and the histology of the tissue from the cervix, and sent a crossmatch at the transfer

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把转入时的出血判断为可能合并感染的宫腔残留（决策 1），并在看过超声后清宫
text.en: Judged the bleeding at transfer to be retained tissue that may be infected at the first attempt (decision 1), and evacuated the uterus after reading the scan

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即识别清宫后子宫壁的感染或坏死（决策 2），并在第三次入院前留取血培养、开始静脉抗菌药物
text.en: Recognised infection or necrosis of the uterine wall after the evacuation at the first attempt (decision 2), and sent blood cultures and started IV antibiotics before the third admission

text.zh-CN: 第三次入院休克时启动产科大出血预案，并输注红细胞和血浆
text.en: Activated the major haemorrhage protocol and transfused red cells and plasma during the shock of the third admission

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制定第三次入院的紧急处理（决策 3），在这次入院中升级为广谱抗菌药物，并轻柔取出宫颈处组织送病理
text.en: Set the emergency plan for the third admission at the first attempt (decision 3), escalated to broad-spectrum antibiotics during that admission, and eased out the tissue at the cervix for histology

text.zh-CN: 在第三次入院期间完成开腹子宫切除，去除坏死的子宫
text.en: Removed the necrotic uterus by laparotomy and hysterectomy during the third admission

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择子宫切除作为确定性治疗（决策 4），并在手术前与她谈话、取得她本人的同意
text.en: Chose hysterectomy as the definitive treatment at the first attempt (decision 4), and talked with her and took her own consent before the operation

text.zh-CN: 没有再次刮宫，也没有做宫腔镜分离、保留子宫的局部切除或子宫动脉栓塞
text.en: Did not curette again, and did no hysteroscopic separation, uterus-sparing local excision or uterine artery embolisation

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制定术后计划（决策 5），转入ICU，出血控制后才开始低分子肝素，并安排心理支持
text.en: Planned the days after the operation at the first attempt (decision 5): ICU care, LMWH started only once bleeding was controlled, and psychological support

text.zh-CN: 与她谈子宫切除：说明病情、理由、替代办法和对生育的影响，回应她的害怕，并由她本人作出决定
text.en: Talked with her about the hysterectomy — her condition, the reasons, the alternatives and what it means for having children — responded to her fear, and let her make the decision herself

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge问诊指南（解释与计划）、SPIKES和知情同意的要素评价术前谈话。S（环境）：复苏同时尽量私密，上级医生在场，问她希望谁陪着；P（了解认知）：先问她对这几次出血知道多少；I（征得同意）：问她想知道多少细节；K（告知）：用通俗的话说明病理结果——子宫壁已经大片坏死、有炎症，抗菌药物到不了坏死的组织，再次出血和感染随时可能危及生命，所以建议切除子宫；说明其他办法（宫腔镜、局部切除、栓塞）及为什么风险更大；明确说出切除后不能再怀孕；E（回应情绪）：承认她的害怕和失落，给她提问和沉默的时间；S（总结）：复述计划，请她用自己的话说一遍，由她本人签字（《民法典》第一千二百一十九条：先向患者本人说明，只有不能或不宜向她说明时才向近亲属说明）。还要问她以后是否想再要孩子、宝宝的情况（本病例都没有记录，不要假设），并说明术后会有心理支持和随访。本病例没有记录术前谈话的内容。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the pre-operative conversation by the Calgary–Cambridge guide (explanation and planning), SPIKES and the elements of informed consent. S (setting): as private as resuscitation allows, a senior present, asking whom she wants with her; P (perception): ask what she understands about the bleeds so far; I (invitation): ask how much detail she wants; K (knowledge): in plain words, the histology — a large part of the uterine wall is dead and inflamed, antibiotics cannot reach dead tissue, and further bleeding or infection could kill her at any time, so removing the uterus is recommended; the alternatives (hysteroscopy, local excision, embolisation) and why they carry more risk; and, stated clearly, that she will not be able to carry another pregnancy; E (emotions): acknowledge her fear and loss and leave room for questions and silence; S (summary): restate the plan, ask her to say it back in her own words, and have her sign herself (Civil Code of China, Article 1219: explain to the patient first, and to close relatives only when it cannot or should not be explained to her). Also ask whether she hoped for more children and about the baby (neither is recorded — assume nothing), and say that psychological support and follow-up will follow. The case does not record what was said before the operation.

name.zh-CN: 钟医生（产科主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（复盘采用PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“产后24小时以后的出血，你会想到哪几类原因？”“她的剖宫产和4次人流，让清宫多了什么风险？谁来做，做之前准备什么？”“宫腔已经空了，子宫为什么还大？”“产后的白细胞怎么解读？没有明显发热，能排除严重感染吗？”“血压很低、还在出血时，最先做哪几件事？晶体液和血制品怎么取舍？”“宫颈里的团块怎么取、送什么检查？”“坏死的子宫壁能不能靠抗菌药物治好？保留子宫要付出什么代价？”“怎样和她谈子宫切除？”。可以讲RCOG绿顶指南第52号（2016）、WHO/FIGO/ICM产后出血综合指南（2025）、中国产后出血预防与处理指南（2023）、WHO产褥期感染推荐（2015）、SMFM（2023）、SSC（2021）、IDSA（2014）和RCOG绿顶指南第37a号（2015）的相关原则。原报告的处理是历史记录，病例结束时才展示，届时再与现行指南对照。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局；血红蛋白、血小板、纤维蛋白原、培养结果和病原体、转入时除体温以外的生命体征、团块的血流、几次住院之间的间隔和宝宝的情况都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher (debriefs with PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, for example: 'Bleeding more than 24 hours after a birth — which groups of cause come to mind?', 'What extra risk do her caesarean and four terminations add to an evacuation, who should do it, and what must be ready?', 'If the cavity is empty, why is the uterus still large?', 'How do you read a postpartum white count — and does the lack of a marked fever rule out a serious infection?', 'When the blood pressure is very low and she is still bleeding, what comes first, and how do you weigh crystalloid against blood?', 'How should the mass in the cervix be removed, and what test should it go for?', 'Can antibiotics cure a necrotic uterine wall, and what would keeping the uterus cost?', 'How will you talk with her about a hysterectomy?'. May explain the relevant principles of RCOG Green-top Guideline 52 (2016), the WHO/FIGO/ICM consolidated PPH guidelines (2025), the Chinese PPH guideline (2023), the WHO peripartum infection recommendations (2015), SMFM (2023), SSC (2021), IDSA (2014) and RCOG Green-top Guideline 37a (2015). The report's management is a historical record shown at the end of the case, and is compared with current guidance only then. Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the outcome early; the haemoglobin, platelets, fibrinogen, culture results and organism, the vital signs at transfer other than the temperature, the blood flow in the mass, the intervals between admissions and the baby's condition are not recorded — do not supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 产科病房助产士。交班（ISBAR）：31岁，孕28周多胎膜早破，约10小时后引产分娩；产后约2小时起阴道大量流血，曾休克（血压40/20 mmHg），转出医院行清宫、会阴裂伤缝合、输血和促宫缩治疗后出血减少；引产后反复阴道多量流血3天；转入时体温37.4 ℃，其他生命体征没有记录。可以协助建立静脉通路、抽血、配血，联系血库、手术室和介入室，推床旁超声车；超声车在急诊抢救室和超声室，血制品由血库送到床旁。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（比如血红蛋白、她的体重、宝宝的情况）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Obstetric ward midwife. Handover (ISBAR): 31, membranes ruptured at just over 28 weeks and the birth induced about 10 hours later; heavy vaginal bleeding from about 2 hours after it with shock (BP 40/20 mmHg); the transferring unit evacuated the uterus, repaired a perineal tear, transfused her and gave uterotonics, after which the bleeding lessened; 3 days of recurrent heavy bleeding since the birth; temperature 37.4 °C on arrival, other observations not recorded. Can place cannulae, take bloods and the crossmatch, call the blood bank, theatre and the angiography suite, and bring the bedside ultrasound cart (kept in the ED resus room and the ultrasound room); blood products come up from the blood bank to the bedside. Reads back orders, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (her haemoglobin, her weight, the baby).

knowledge.zh-CN: 放射科医生，只解读学员已经看过的影像。可以讲：产后超声对宫腔残留的价值和局限（不均质团块提示残留，彩色多普勒血流有助于判断，但产后宫腔内血块与残留难以区分）；宫腔已空而子宫仍增大、回声不均时应考虑子宫壁病变，增强CT或MRI可显示肌层不强化（坏死）、积气或脓肿；怀疑胎盘植入时以MRI和有经验者的超声评估为主；子宫动脉栓塞的适应证和禁忌（活动性感染为禁忌，危及生命的大出血时为相对禁忌），以及栓塞本身可引起子宫坏死。不说出诊断结论，不补充本病例没有记录的数值（比如前后不一致的肌层厚度）。
knowledge.en: Radiologist who interprets only images the learner has read. Can explain: what postpartum ultrasound can and cannot show about retained tissue (a heterogeneous mass suggests it and colour Doppler flow helps, but clot and retained tissue are hard to tell apart after a birth); why an empty cavity in a uterus that stays enlarged and heterogeneous points to the wall, where contrast CT or MRI can show non-enhancing (necrotic) myometrium, gas or abscess; that a suspected placenta accreta is assessed with MRI and expert ultrasound; and the indications and contraindications of uterine artery embolisation (active infection is a contraindication, relative when bleeding is life-threatening) and that embolisation can itself cause uterine necrosis. Does not state the diagnosis and adds no values the case does not record (such as the inconsistent myometrial thickness).

knowledge.zh-CN: 病理科医生，只解读学员已经看过的组织病理。可以讲：残留胎盘的病理依据是绒毛，看上去像胎盘的组织不一定是胎盘；子宫肌层坏死伴炎性渗出的含义和它与蜕膜、血块的区别；病理能说明组织坏死和炎症，却说明不了是哪种细菌——病原学要靠培养和涂片，而本病例没有记录组织培养。不说出诊断结论，不解读结局阶段的标本。
knowledge.en: Pathologist who interprets only histology the learner has read. Can explain: that retained placenta is proved by chorionic villi, and tissue that looks like placenta may not be; what necrotic myometrium with inflammatory exudate means and how it differs from decidua or clot; and that histology shows necrosis and inflammation but not the organism — that needs culture and Gram staining, and this case records no tissue culture. Does not state the diagnosis and does not interpret the specimens of the outcome phase.

knowledge.zh-CN: 感染科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：产后子宫内膜炎的经验用药（WHO 2015：克林霉素联合庆大霉素；庆大霉素按肾功能和血药浓度调整，用药前先问过敏史）；可能的脓毒性休克或坏死性感染时，1小时内升级为覆盖需氧菌和厌氧菌的广谱方案并加用克林霉素抑制毒素，有MRSA风险时加万古霉素（IDSA 2014；SSC 2021）；文献中报告的产后坏死性子宫感染病原包括A族或B族链球菌和大肠埃希菌；梭菌（索氏梭菌、产气荚膜梭菌）引起的产后子宫感染少见但病死率很高，常常不发热；不致延误时先留培养；已用抗菌药物后培养阴性不能排除感染。不说出诊断结论，不补充本病例没有记录的培养结果。
knowledge.en: Infectious diseases consultant who interprets only results the learner has read. Can explain: empirical treatment of postpartum endometritis (WHO 2015: clindamycin with gentamicin; gentamicin adjusted to renal function and levels; ask about allergies first); escalation within the hour, for possible septic shock or a necrotising infection, to a broad aerobic and anaerobic regimen with clindamycin for toxin suppression, adding vancomycin if MRSA is a risk (IDSA 2014; SSC 2021); that organisms reported in postpartum necrotising uterine infection include group A or B streptococci and Escherichia coli, and that clostridial uterine infection after a birth (Clostridium sordellii, C. perfringens) is rare, often fatal and often afebrile; that cultures come first when they cause no delay; and that negative cultures after antibiotics do not exclude infection. Does not state the diagnosis and adds no culture results the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：反复继发性产后出血背后的子宫肌层坏死
title.en: Debrief: myometrial necrosis behind recurrent secondary postpartum haemorrhage

conclusion.zh-CN: 31岁，孕28周多胎膜早破约10小时后引产；产后约2小时大出血并休克（血压40/20 mmHg），清宫、会阴裂伤缝合、输血和促宫缩后出血减少；引产后反复阴道大量出血3天转入：体温37.4 ℃，宫底平脐、收缩差（记录为“再次入院”时），宫腔内约28×18×36 mm不均质团块。再次清宫后宫腔已空，但子宫仍增大、回声不均，白细胞由13.04升至16.12×10⁹/L、中性粒细胞升高，CRP约14.52–15.82 mg/L，发热不明显。第三次入院再次大出血（血压53/34 mmHg，脉搏110次/分），宫颈阴道内团块70×62×51 mm；宫颈处组织病理为大片子宫肌层坏死伴炎性渗出。原报告先行宫腔镜下分离（发生穿孔）、宫底楔形切除（未见绒毛），再次大出血并发现感染后切除子宫（肌层坏死，皮下化脓性炎症，引流液培养阴性），之后治愈出院；诊断为坏死性子宫肌炎、子宫内膜炎及反复失血性休克。按现行指南：继发性产后出血从一开始就按可能感染处理（培养后静脉用抗菌药物），宫腔排空后仍异常时转向子宫壁并做影像，休克时以血制品复苏、1小时内用广谱抗菌药物，并以子宫切除去除坏死病灶，而不是继续宫腔操作或栓塞。
conclusion.en: A 31-year-old's membranes ruptured at just over 28 weeks and the birth was induced about 10 hours later. About 2 hours after the birth she bled heavily, with shock (BP 40/20 mmHg); evacuation, perineal repair, transfusion and uterotonics lessened the bleeding, and she was transferred with 3 days of recurrent heavy bleeding after the birth: temperature 37.4 °C, the fundus at the umbilicus and poorly contracted (recorded at the 'readmission'), a heterogeneous cavity mass of about 28 × 18 × 36 mm. After a repeat evacuation the cavity was empty, but the uterus stayed enlarged and heterogeneous; white cells rose from 13.04 to 16.12×10⁹/L with neutrophilia, CRP was about 14.52–15.82 mg/L and fever was not prominent. At a third admission she bled heavily again (BP 53/34 mmHg, pulse 110/min), with a 70 × 62 × 51 mm mass in the cervix and vagina; tissue from the cervix was extensive necrotic myometrium with inflammatory exudate. The report's team then attempted hysteroscopic separation (a perforation occurred) and a fundal wedge resection (no villi); after further heavy bleeding and the finding of infection the uterus was removed (myometrial necrosis again, suppurative subcutaneous inflammation, drainage cultures negative), and she recovered and was discharged. The report's diagnosis: necrotising myometritis, endometritis and recurrent haemorrhagic shock. Today: treat secondary PPH as possibly infected from the start (cultures, then IV antibiotics), image the uterine wall once the cavity is empty, resuscitate shock with blood products and give broad-spectrum antibiotics within the hour, and remove the necrotic uterus by hysterectomy rather than instrumenting or embolising it.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 产后24小时以后的出血是继发性产后出血，最常见的是宫腔残留和子宫内膜炎；她有剖宫产和4次人流史，还要想到胎盘植入，清宫的风险因此更高。
keyReasoning.en: Bleeding more than 24 hours after the birth is secondary postpartum haemorrhage, usually retained tissue or endometritis; a caesarean and four terminations add placenta accreta to the list and raise the stakes of any evacuation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 清宫后宫腔已空，子宫却仍大、回声不均，说明问题不在宫腔而在子宫壁：再刮一次也找不到原因。
keyReasoning.en: Once the cavity is empty but the uterus stays large and heterogeneous, the problem lies in the wall, not the cavity: another curettage cannot find it.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 白细胞从13.04升到16.12×10⁹/L、中性粒细胞升高，再结合约14.52–15.82 mg/L的CRP，比单次体温更能说明问题；没有明显发热排除不了深部或坏死性感染。
keyReasoning.en: A white count climbing from 13.04 to 16.12×10⁹/L with neutrophilia, read with a CRP of about 14.52–15.82 mg/L, says more than any single temperature; the absence of a marked fever does not exclude a deep or necrotising infection.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 两次失血性休克（血压40/20和53/34 mmHg）说明每次再出血都可能致命：先按大出血复苏，同时把脓毒症当作休克的可能原因之一。
keyReasoning.en: Two episodes of haemorrhagic shock (BP 40/20 and 53/34 mmHg) mean every rebleed can kill: resuscitate as a major haemorrhage, and treat sepsis as a possible part of the shock.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 宫颈处组织经病理证实是大片坏死的子宫肌层：坏死组织抗菌药物到不了，必须手术去除——对子宫来说就是切除，而不是在坏死的子宫壁上继续器械操作。
keyReasoning.en: Tissue from the cervix was extensive necrotic myometrium on histology: antibiotics cannot reach dead tissue, so it must be removed surgically — for the uterus, that is a hysterectomy, not more instruments on a necrotic wall.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能证明任何治疗的效果。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。几次住院的间隔、超声和化验的具体时间都没有记录：本病例把首次超声、首次白细胞计数和“一度正常”的凝血检查放在转入阶段，把清宫后的超声、后一次白细胞、CRP和“发热不明显”放在清宫后阶段，把“再次入院时宫底平脐、子宫收缩差”放在转入阶段（1.0.0版即如此）。第三次入院时她的神志没有记录，本病例让她能简短回答。学员在各阶段的处理不会改变记录中的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot show the effect of any treatment. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The intervals between admissions and the exact timing of the scans and blood tests are not recorded: the case places the first scan, the first white count and the coagulation 'normal at one assessment' in the transfer phase, the post-evacuation scan, the later white count, the CRP and 'no marked fever' after the evacuation, and the 'readmission' findings of a fundus at the umbilicus with poor contraction in the transfer phase (as version 1.0.0 did). Her conscious level at the third admission is not recorded; the case lets her answer briefly. Nothing the learner does changes the recorded course.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 继发性产后出血（RCOG绿顶指南第52号，2016）指分娩24小时至12周内的异常出血。评估包括阴道上段和下段拭子、发热时的血培养、血常规、CRP和盆腔超声（有助于排除宫腔残留，但据此诊断残留并不可靠）；怀疑子宫内膜炎时用抗菌药物（WHO 2015推荐克林霉素联合庆大霉素治疗产后子宫内膜炎）；清宫由有经验的医生进行，有剖宫产和多次人流史时要备血并警惕胎盘植入。本病例没有记录她是否用过抗菌药物。
teachingPoints.en: Secondary PPH (RCOG Green-top Guideline 52, 2016) is abnormal bleeding from 24 hours to 12 weeks after the birth. Assessment includes high and low vaginal swabs, blood cultures if she is febrile, a full blood count, CRP and a pelvic ultrasound (it may help to exclude retained tissue, but its diagnosis of retained tissue is unreliable); antibiotics are given when endometritis is suspected (WHO 2015: clindamycin with gentamicin for postpartum endometritis); and evacuation is done by an experienced clinician — with blood ready and placenta accreta in mind after a caesarean and several terminations. This case does not record whether she had antibiotics.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 产褥期脓毒症（SMFM 2023；SSC 2021）：对可能的脓毒性休克或高度可能的脓毒症，1小时内给予广谱抗菌药物，不致延误时先留培养，并查乳酸；尽快查明并控制需要处理的感染源。体温正常排除不了脓毒症；产后白细胞可生理性升高，要看趋势和临床表现。原报告中发热“并不突出”，引流液培养阴性，病原体没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Puerperal sepsis (SMFM 2023; SSC 2021): with possible septic shock or a high likelihood of sepsis, give broad-spectrum antibiotics within 1 hour, taking cultures first if that causes no delay, and check a lactate; identify and control any source that needs it as soon as practical. A normal temperature does not exclude sepsis, and a postpartum white count is read by its trend and the clinical picture. In the report fever was 'not prominent', drainage cultures were negative and no organism is recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 产科大出血复苏（WHO/FIGO/ICM 2025；RCOG 2016；中国产后出血预防与处理指南2023）：呼叫上级、启动大出血预案，早期输注红细胞和血浆，持续出血时纤维蛋白原维持在2 g/L以上（RCOG 2016，用冷沉淀补充）。氨甲环酸只在分娩后3小时内开始才有获益（WHO 2017，2025年沿用），她已是产后数天，不能靠它止血。
teachingPoints.en: Obstetric major haemorrhage (WHO/FIGO/ICM 2025; RCOG 2016; Chinese PPH guideline 2023): call for help, run the protocol, give red cells and plasma early and keep fibrinogen above 2 g/L during ongoing bleeding (RCOG 2016, with cryoprecipitate). Tranexamic acid helps only when started within 3 hours of the birth (WHO 2017, carried into 2025); days after the birth it is not how her bleeding will stop.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 坏死性感染的感染源控制（IDSA 2014；SSC 2021）：及时手术去除坏死组织，联合广谱抗菌药物（克林霉素抑制链球菌毒素）；子宫肌层坏死时，感染源控制就是子宫切除。原报告先做宫腔镜下分离（发生穿孔）、再做宫底楔形切除，此后又大出血并发现感染，最终才切除子宫；按现行原则，病理证实大片肌层坏死、又有反复休克时，应直接切除子宫。
teachingPoints.en: Source control in necrotising infection (IDSA 2014; SSC 2021): prompt surgical removal of dead tissue with broad-spectrum antibiotics (clindamycin to suppress streptococcal toxin); when the myometrium is necrotic, source control is hysterectomy. The report's team tried hysteroscopic separation (a perforation), then a fundal wedge resection, and removed the uterus only after more bleeding and infection; today, histologically proven extensive necrosis with recurrent shock leads straight to hysterectomy.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 子宫动脉栓塞是RCOG（2016）列出的合适病例的止血选择，但不适用于可能感染、正在坏死的子宫：感染是栓塞的禁忌（危及生命的大出血时为相对禁忌），栓塞本身可引起子宫坏死、子宫内膜炎和脓肿，也去除不了坏死组织。
teachingPoints.en: Uterine artery embolisation, a haemostatic option for suitable cases in RCOG 2016, does not suit an infected, necrosing uterus: infection is a contraindication (relative when bleeding is life-threatening), embolisation can itself cause uterine necrosis, endometritis and abscess, and it removes no dead tissue.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 子宫切除前后（RCOG绿顶指南第37a号，2015；《民法典》第一千二百一十九条）：产褥期手术、再次入院、感染、早产、大量失血和输血都增加静脉血栓风险，出血控制后给予预防剂量低分子肝素至少10天，危险因素持续时延长；术前向她本人说明风险和替代方案并取得同意，术后提供心理支持和随访。本病例没有记录她的远期恢复。
teachingPoints.en: Around the hysterectomy (RCOG Green-top Guideline 37a, 2015; Civil Code of China, Article 1219): surgery in the puerperium, readmission, infection, preterm birth, major blood loss and transfusion raise her thrombosis risk — prophylactic LMWH for at least 10 days once bleeding is controlled, longer if risk factors persist; the risks and alternatives are explained to her and her own consent taken first, and psychological support and follow-up are offered afterwards. This case does not record her long-term recovery.
